page.overview:
Who is Big & Tall Hazmat Suit Store Clerk?

The Big & Tall Hazmat Suit Store Clerk is a man who works at the Big & Tall Hazmat Suit Store kiosk at the Atomic-Con Nuclear Power Convention.

He offers Homer advice on how to save someone's life before Homer rejects his offer and asks for more swag.
